Ledesma IV]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Nationalist People's Coalition}}|border=darkgray}} [[Nationalist People's Coalition|NPC]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Negros Occidental's 1st congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Negros Occidental]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 14, 2020}} The district consists of the northern Negros Occidental cities of [[Escalante, Negros Occidental|Escalante]] and [[San Carlos, Negros Occidental|San Carlos]], as well as adjacent municipalities of [[Calatrava, Negros Occidental|Calatrava]], [[Don Salvador Benedicto]] and [[Toboso, Negros Occidental|Toboso]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Jules Ledesma|Julio A.
